timing.scope: Development performance only. First-fit timing includes fit work; outer process cost additionally includes imports/controller/serialization. Later fits reuse process caches but adapt freshly. Missing timings remain missing; all process failures charged.

limitations: Two fixed sparse market posteriors and paired streams; not calibration or market utility evidence.
Full cohort ratios require all three fits on both arms to pass; failed/missing work remains in denominator.
Controller transport validation reused, with independent final health/precision gate and normalized parity/reset checks.
